它装着两份 2014 年 1 月 31 日的真实历史格点：近地风和近表层洋流。可: It holds two real historical fields labelled 31 January 2014: near-ground wind and upper-ocean currents. Orbit, zoom and explore whenever you like.
走近北大西洋。青色线来自洋流格点；点击别处，仪表会读出当地的真实插值速度。: Come closer to the North Atlantic. Cyan lines come from current data. Select another location and the instrument reads its interpolated velocity.
风从哪里来，水往哪里去: Where wind comes from; where water goes
铜色是风，青色是海水。风向仪表报告来向，箭头与轨迹显示去向；两种速度并不相同。: Copper is wind; cyan is water. The wind instrument reports its origin direction, while arrows and tracks show travel direction. Their speeds differ too.
把两个标记放在同一处: Release two markers at one location
让空气与海水从相同经纬度出发。它们用同一个时钟，按各自的速度，在冻结的历史场里积: Start air and water at the same coordinates. They share one clock and integrate their own velocities through frozen historical fields.
从黑潮到南大洋，再到赤道太平洋。区域卡带你靠近，轨迹和读数仍来自同一份历史数据。: From the Kuroshio to the Southern Ocean and equatorial Pacific. Region cards move the camera; tracks and readings still use the same historical data.
把路线留下来，回看途中: Keep the route. Revisit the journey.
下方的时间条可以回看已经算过的路线。缺测时标记停在最后一个有效点，不把它解释成真: Use the time bar to replay routes already calculated. A marker stops at the last valid point when data run out. That is not a simulated beaching.
可旋转的风与洋流地球: Rotatable globe of wind and ocean currents
同一颗地球，两层看不见的运动。: One planet. Two invisible layers of motion.
颜色表示速度，流线显示去向: Colour is speed; streamlines show travel direction
点地球，放出所选介质的标记: Select the globe to release the chosen marker

冻结场积分 · 流线循环只示方向: Frozen-field integration · Loops indicate direction only
格点暂时没有载入，请重试。: The fields could not load. Please try again.
风向仪表按来向读数；罗盘、箭头和标记都朝运动去向。点击地球，可以逐点测量。: Wind bearings report where wind comes from. The compass, arrows and markers show where motion goes. Select the globe to measure any point.
让一条路线自己长出来: Let a route grow on its own
在选点放标记，或切换“放标记”后直接点地球。轨迹按真实速度积分；背景流线的循环不: Release at the selected point, or choose Release and select the globe. Tracks integrate real velocities; background loops do not measure elapsed drift.
相邻起点约隔二十多公里。这里的分散只来自冻结场的速度差，不含湍流扩散。: Starting points are roughly twenty kilometres apart. Separation comes only from differences in the frozen field, not turbulent diffusion.
还没有标记。先在一片有数据的海上放一个。: No markers yet. Start over an ocean location with data.
最前两个标记的间距: Distance between the first two markers
这些入口只是镜头位置。流线、探针和漂流仍来自同一组历史格点，没有预先画好的流向。: These entries move the camera. Streamlines, probes and drift still come from the same historical fields, without hand-drawn flow directions.
这份数据能告诉我们什么: What these data can tell us
风：2014-01-31 00:00 UTC 起报、预报三小时的 GFS 十米风: Wind: GFS 10-m winds, 1° grid, from the 2014-01-31 00:00 UTC cycle at +3 h. Ocean: an OSCAR ⅓° five-day product labelled 2014-01-31, representing an upper-30-m mean; the original converted file carries a 15-m depth label.
只各有一帧。播放不更新天气；漂流把这一帧保持不变，最长三十天，不是实际漂流预测。: One frame per product. Playback does not update weather. Drift freezes each field for at most thirty days; it is not a real-world drift forecast. Missing current cells are not zero-filled; tracks stop at their boundary.
球面积分使用各产品的参考地球半径；相同位置的两种速度不代表瞬时因果关系。图层高度: Spherical integration uses each product's reference Earth radius. Velocities at the same location do not imply instantaneous causation. Layer heights, arrow lengths and globe illumination are designed for legibility.
从北美东岸向东北找，看看海水怎样转弯、分叉和卷成涡旋。这里的细节来自 2014: Look northeast from the North American coast: water turns, forks and forms eddies. These details come from 2014 OSCAR cells. Release neighbours and see whether nearby starts grow apart.
黑潮离开海岸以后: After the Kuroshio leaves the coast
沿着日本南侧走向外海，寻找这份快照里的强流带。海岸附近有缺测，标记会在缺测边界停: Look offshore from southern Japan for strong flow bands in this snapshot. Coastal data can be missing; a marker stops at that data boundary, not at a modelled beach.
同一片海，风和水会同向吗: Do wind and water head the same way?
把风和洋流叠在一起，在同一处各放一个标记。它们使用各自的真实速度，并共享漂流时钟: Overlay wind and current and release a marker of each at one location. Their actual velocities share a drift clock, while the wind and five-day current product have different time scales.
绕过地球的水与风: Water and wind around a planet
把镜头转向南纬四五十度，沿着南大洋寻找较连续的流带。经纬网能帮你辨认纬度；OSC: Turn toward latitudes 40–50°S and look for relatively continuous flow bands. The graticule helps identify latitude. OSCAR has no coverage beyond 80°S.
这里是 2014 年一月底，不是今天，也不能用它概括全年。看看阿拉伯海与赤道两侧: This is late January 2014, not today or the whole year. Measure vectors in the Arabian Sea and on both sides of the equator, then compare air and water tracks.
从北美西侧转到亚洲东侧，寻找大范围弯曲的流线。漂流轨迹只把这一帧保持不变，不包含: Turn from western North America to eastern Asia and find broad curved streamlines. Drift holds this one frame fixed; future weather, tides, waves and object windage are absent.
水流在大陆边缘转身: A current turns along a continent
在非洲东南侧和南端附近寻找较强的海流。移动测量点，比较顺着风走的空气与沿海水速度: Find stronger currents off southeastern and southern Africa. Move the probe and compare an air marker with a water-velocity marker, watching the angle between them.
这一层是 GFS 在 2014 年 1 月 31 日 03:00 UTC 的十米: GFS 10-m winds valid at 2014-01-31 03:00 UTC include land. Wind bearings follow the meteorological from convention; streamline animation and markers move toward the destination direction.
